quantile_algorithm: DuckDB quantile_cont; Hyndman-Fan type 7 on finite DOUBLE train values
bin_boundary: right_closed; deduplicate cuts; remove cuts equal to min or max
score_order: descending exact rational score; same score shares a rank
tie_break: SHA256(UTF8(target-v1|20260921| + row_id)) ascending; row_id ascending if hash collision
bootstrap_unit: record; stratify by original treatment; joint selection bitmask multinomial
bootstrap_conditioning: fixed train bins, scores, valid membership, original actual capacity
interval: numpy linear percentile 2.5/97.5; marginal descriptive, not simultaneous
